headline: Nigerian Digital Bank Kuda Cuts 40 Jobs to Target 2027 Profitability
summary: Nigerian fintech and digital banking platform Kuda conducted a second round of layoffs in 2026, cutting 40 positions as it streamlines operational expenses to achieve group profitability by 2027.
why: African fintech startups are shifting focus from rapid user acquisition to sustainable operating margins amid tighter venture funding.

impacts.name: Kuda Technologies
impacts.why: Cutting 40 positions lowers operating expenses as the neobank targets profitability in 2027.
